description: This file defines a class for processing and analyzing medical images using OpenAI's GPT-4V model. It includes methods for reading image files, encoding them, constructing prompts, and making asynchronous API calls to generate medical image analyses.

classes.name: ImageProcessor
classes.description: A class to process and analyze medical images using GPT-4V, encapsulating image encoding, prompt creation, and API interaction.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ImageProcessor with an OpenAI API client using the API key from settings.

methods.name: analyze_image
methods.description: Asynchronously analyzes a medical image at the given path, optionally using contextual text, by sending a prompt to GPT-4V and returning the analysis results.
